name: cmmn-lens
description: Shows the local Flowable CMMN, BPMN or DMN file Claude is editing in an interactive viewer beside the chat, and tells Claude what you select.

selection_context.title: Add the viewer selection to prompts
selection_context.description: Before each prompt, tell Claude which elements you have selected in a cmmn-lens viewer, so you can say "this task" without naming it.
